Test move declaration refactoring: import additions and deletions.

-- capabilities.json --
{
	"experimental":{"interactiveResolve":{"inputTypes":["string"]}}
}

-- settings.json --
{
	"moveDeclaration": true
}

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- go.mod --
module golang.org/lsptests/movedeclimports

go 1.20

-- dest/dest.go --
package dest

func Existing() {}

-- dest/has_import.go --
package dest

import "strings"

func Join(a, b string) string {
	return strings.Join([]string{a, b}, "")
}

-- src/single.go --
package src

import "bytes"

func WriteBuf(b *bytes.Buffer) { //@codeaction(re"WriteBuf", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_single_import)
	b.WriteString("hello")
}

-- src/dup_import.go --
package src

import "strings"

func HasPrefix(s string) bool { //@codeaction(re"HasPrefix", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/has_import.go"}`, result=move_dup_import)
	return strings.HasPrefix(s, "a")
}

-- src/newfile.go --
package src

import "bytes"

func MakeBuf() *bytes.Buffer { //@codeaction(re"MakeBuf", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/newfile.go"}`, result=move_new_file_import)
	return new(bytes.Buffer)
}

-- src/shared.go --
package src

import "fmt"

func MoveMe() { //@codeaction(re"MoveMe", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_shared_import)
	fmt.Println("moving")
}

func StayMe() {
	fmt.Println("staying")
}

-- src/multi_spec.go --
package src

import (
	"bytes"
	"strings"
)

func MoveBytes(b *bytes.Buffer) { //@codeaction(re"MoveBytes", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_multi_spec_import)
	b.Reset()
}

func StayStrings(s string) bool {
	return strings.Contains(s, "x")
}

-- @move_single_import/src/single.go --
package src



func WriteBuf(b *bytes.Buffer) { //@codeaction(re"WriteBuf", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_single_import)
	b.WriteString("hello")
}

-- @move_single_import/dest/dest.go --
package dest

import "bytes"

func Existing() {}

func WriteBuf(b *bytes.Buffer) {
	b.WriteString("hello")
}
-- @move_dup_import/src/dup_import.go --
package src

	return strings.HasPrefix(s, "a")
}

-- @move_dup_import/dest/has_import.go --
package dest

import "strings"

func Join(a, b string) string {
	return strings.Join([]string{a, b}, "")
}

func HasPrefix(s string) bool {
	return strings.HasPrefix(s, "a")
}

	return new(bytes.Buffer)
}

)

func MakeBuf() *bytes.Buffer {
	return new(bytes.Buffer)
}

import "fmt"

func Existing() {}

	fmt.Println("moving")
}
-- @move_multi_spec_import/src/multi_spec.go --
package src

import (
	
	"strings"
)

func MoveBytes(b *bytes.Buffer) { //@codeaction(re"MoveBytes", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_multi_spec_import)
	b.Reset()
}

func StayStrings(s string) bool {
	return strings.Contains(s, "x")
}

-- @move_multi_spec_import/dest/dest.go --
package dest

import "bytes"

func Existing() {}

func MoveBytes(b *bytes.Buffer) {
	b.Reset()
